message.content:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate bilateral, patchy airspace consolidations (particularly visible in the right mid-to-lower zone on the PA view), which is the classic radiological presentation of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP). This pattern, combined with the clinical history of steroid responsiveness and relapse upon tapering, strongly supports COP over fibrosis, nodules, or lymphadenopathy.
